description: Authoritative IP-value assessment and rewrite-by-value migration inventory for Product Forge modules (BI-PF-0386 / ADR-0001).

tier_1.name: High IP / Sensitive
tier_1.policy: New logic must be Go; existing Python rewritten first; strict edit growth bounds

tier_2.name: Medium IP / Core Capabilities
tier_2.distribution: Native compiled binary (Nuitka stopgap until Go rewrite)
tier_2.policy: Migrate by value; edits allowed in Python within 60-line growth limit

tier_3.name: Low IP / Plumbing & Utilities
tier_3.distribution: Nuitka C-extension binary; zero readable .py at customer
tier_3.policy: Retain compiled Python; low migration priority

tier_4.name: Tooling & Build-Time
tier_4.policy: Stays Python; excluded from customer edition packaging
